en: I like apples.
This is my book.
It's a red car.
I can swim.
I have a pencil.
I see a big tree.
It's time for bed.
I want some water.
Please open the door.
Thank you for your help.
She is my friend.
Where is the dog?
The cat is sleeping.
My mother is reading.
I'm drawing a picture.
Let's play with the ball.
I can't find my bag.
The giraffe is very tall.
The banana is yellow.
I go to school.
There are three books on the desk.
My mother goes to work by bus.
zh: 我妈妈坐公交车去上班。

en: I usually get up at seven.
The boy is playing football in the park.
zh: 这个男孩在公园里踢足球。

en: We have music class on Mondays.
She likes reading story books after school.
zh: 她喜欢放学后读故事书。

en: Please close the window before you go out.
My father is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
I can ride a bike very well.
There is a big tree behind our house.
zh: 我们家屋后有一棵大树。

en: The bird is flying in the sky.
We will go to the zoo this Sunday.
zh: 这个星期天我们要去动物园。

en: He is taller than his little brother.
I finished my homework after dinner.
Do you want to play basketball with us?
zh: 你想和我们一起打篮球吗？

en: My school is not far from my home.
I often help my mother clean the room.
zh: 我经常帮妈妈打扫房间。

en: We should keep the classroom clean.
zh: 我们应该保持教室干净。

en: We had a birthday party for my little sister.
zh: 我们给妹妹办了一个生日聚会。

en: It is important to eat breakfast every day.
When I grow up, I want to be a doctor.
I like reading books because they take me to different places.
zh: 我喜欢读书，因为它们能带我去不同的地方。

en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home and watch a movie.
zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里看电影。

en: My best friend is good at math, but I am better at English.
zh: 我最好的朋友擅长数学，但我更擅长英语。

en: There are many tall buildings and busy streets in the city.
zh: 城市里有许多高楼和繁忙的街道。

en: I have to finish my homework before I can play games.
zh: 我得先做完作业才能玩游戏。

en: The Earth is our home, so we must keep it clean.
zh: 地球是我们的家园，所以我们必须保持它干净。

en: It was raining, but we still went to school on time.
zh: 天下着雨，但我们还是准时到了学校。

en: Reading is good for us, and it helps us learn new things.
zh: 阅读对我们有好处，还能帮我们学到新东西。

en: We planted some young trees in the park last spring.
zh: 去年春天我们在公园里种了一些小树。

en: I think learning English well is important for my future.
zh: 我认为学好英语对我的未来很重要。

en: The little boy was so tired that he went to sleep at once.
zh: 小男孩太累了，马上就睡着了。

en: My city has changed a lot in the past ten years.
zh: 我的城市在过去十年里变化很大。

en: Could you tell me how to get to the train station?
zh: 你能告诉我怎么去火车站吗？

en: Playing sports every day can keep us healthy and happy.
zh: 每天运动能让我们健康又快乐。

en: I am looking forward to the summer holiday this year.
We should always be friendly to the people around us.
zh: 我们应该一直对身边的人友好。

en: The book on the desk is mine, and that one is hers.
zh: 桌子上的那本书是我的，那一本是她的。

en: If you don't hurry, you will be late for school.
zh: 如果你不快点，上学就要迟到了。

en: When you cross the road, you must be very careful.
zh: 过马路时你必须非常小心。
